derived_from: example_workflow/fish_audio_s2_tts_example_workflow.json plus the FishS2VoiceCloneTTS schema at the pinned node commit

substitutions.notes: lowercase ISO code or auto; must be a member of the node's LANGUAGES combo
uploaded input path relative to the ComfyUI input directory
optional transcript of the reference audio; recommended for stable cloning
folder name under ComfyUI/models/fishaudioS2; never select an '(auto download)' entry

safety.notes: model_path is a local folder name resolved from ComfyUI/models/fishaudioS2 (symlinked to the central checkpoint); '(auto download)' variants are never selected. keep_model_loaded=true retains the model between narration chunks; Studio releases it once after the narration job when unload_after is enabled. torch.compile is enabled with a fixed 1024-token ceiling (about 47 seconds of audio) to avoid the uncompiled autoregressive path and misleading 32K-token progress estimate.
